summary: Fixed the reviewer’s concrete issues in `src/nomenclature_matcher/candidate_diversification.py`. Structural grouping is now more conservative by adding semantic catalog evidence to the signature, covering relevant properties and observable text markers for material, medium, pass type, thread/configuration, dimensions, series, execution, and related variant-bearing fields. DN/PN payload fields are now validated against explicit text evidence; malformed direct values or conflicting text evidence return no signature, so those candidates remain independently eligible instead of being collapsed. Added focused regressions in `tests/test_candidate_diversification.py` for material, medium, pass type, thread/configuration, installation dimensions, and DN/PN contradictions. No index rebuild is required.
